resources.doc: Terminal business observation wins over any late execution-start report.

resources.name: FulfillmentTaskLink
resources.doc: Kernel task address, not an application EntityRef or business request payload.

resources.name: MetricBreachEffect
resources.doc: A response is separate from the observation and never silently executes work.

resources.name: MetricBreachEvent
resources.doc: Occurrence consumed through Measurements.breach, which verifies the threshold.

resources.name: MetricObservation
resources.doc: Derived candidates are interpreted and verified, not trusted because CRUD succeeded.

classification.business: declared domain errors: served, counted separately
classification.counting: one event per logical operation; retries are attempts on the same event, never new events
